== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：山脈</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、フォース消耗に＋1。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここには自分の帝国軍と戦闘用ビークルを－1で配備できる。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker).

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control this site, add 1 to the Force drain. Dark Side. Your Imperials and combat vehicles may deploy here for 1 less.

Both originals print the same Force icon counts and two side-specific effects. The Japanese title uses 山脈 (mountain range) and 第6マーカー (6th marker).<ref>[[:File:ESB2P-D-hothmountains.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)]].</ref>
